card.title: Your Risk, My Cost
card.instruction: Treat every choice around you as a risk whose consequences may land on you. Press for a voice in decisions you cannot control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you teach the dog to fetch glasses, can I vote? I buy the glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And my experiment is making rent after the breakages.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Include replacing the glasses in your definition of clean.

mechanism: A seeks decision power over a dog experiment because the broken objects and financial consequences belong to them.
confusable: Unlike general caution, A must identify how another person's choice creates costs they will carry.
comparison: S208-a bargains over replacement within cleanup; S208-b expands tent-placement say to fire risk on their lawn.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
